categories_thin: Veterinarians: no veterinary practice inside Milltown borough; the nearest are in East Brunswick/North Brunswick (out of zone).

Pest control, locksmiths, moving/storage, painting/flooring specialists, cleaning services, windows/siding dealers: no Milltown-based independents surfaced in Maps sweeps - they appear to be home-based and listed under neighboring towns.
Tutoring / test prep, driving schools, music schools, art schools, event venues, hotels: nothing found in Milltown.
Retail: only a handful of independents (comics, florist, jeweler, card shop); the rest of the retail base is chain (Home Depot, Target) or food.
Manufacturing/wholesale: only directory-only names (Middlesex Container, Bannister, Priority Distribution); the Ford Ave industrial pocket is small.
Marketing/design/IT and staffing: one directory-only marketing entry and no IT, staffing, title, appraisal or surveying firms found, despite the town's professional-office base.
caveats: Milltown is ~1.6 sq mi. Many businesses carry a 'Milltown' mailing address while sitting in East Brunswick or North Brunswick; entries were kept to streets confirmed inside the borough (N Main St, S Main St, Ryders Ln, Riva Ave, Washington Ave, Van Liew Ave, W Church St, W Lakewood Ave, Ford Ave, Cleveland Ave, Dorothy Ln, Tracey Dr, Clay St).

Google Maps in the visitor browser caps results at roughly five per query ('limited view'); coverage was built from ~22 distinct category sweeps plus two curated local directories and a town sponsor page, so some home-based businesses are likely still missing.

Excluded as out-of-zone after confirmation: Morano Electric (23 Serviss Ave, East Brunswick), Olson's Air Conditioning & Heating (11 Cotters Ln, East Brunswick), Brunswick Remodeling & Contracting (40B Cotters Ln, East Brunswick), I&R Computer (268 Drift St, New Brunswick), Raritan Valley Tree Service (509 Riva Ave, East Brunswick), Jersey Physical Therapy (180 Tices Ln), Sam Income Tax (180 Tices Ln), Marc A. Kane CPA and Dcruz Agency (330 Milltown Rd), Vipul Verma State Farm (525 Milltown Rd), Plus Computer Consulting (93 Milltown Rd), Valora Fitness (772 Carolier Ln), VIO Med Spa and Hidden Lake Animal Hospital (Shoppes Blvd), Anchor Pest Control (28 Arthur St), Good Day Preschool was checked and IS in Milltown so it is included.

Excluded per exclusion rules: The Home Depot and Target (national chains), AFC Urgent Care (national franchise), Kessler Rehabilitation Center (large chain), Saint Peter's Physician Associates (large health system), Honest-1 Auto Care (franchise), Precision Door Service of Central & South Jersey (franchise, 100 Ryders Ln), Gold Medal Service (large regional firm), plus pharmacies, banks, restaurants, delis, liquor stores and bars in the source directories.

Several local sponsor-page businesses (Lozito Law, Marotta & Garvey, Knoblock Auto Body, Logan's Towing, Milltown Auto Service Center, Party People DJs) are confirmed only by the sponsor page and publish no street address.
Zone filtering by street name is partly inferential: a few addresses (Clay St, J F Kennedy Dr, the Van Liew Ave '0' address, Lawrence Brook Dr) should be double-checked by triage.
Bronson & McNamara and Bronson & Guthlein are likely the same funeral home under an old and new name at 152 N Main St - merge if confirmed.
data_gaps: Overpass API (OpenStreetMap) timed out from this environment; OSM data was not used.

Yellow Pages, BBB category pages, Manta, ChamberofCommerce.com, AllBiz, Cataloxy, Cylex, WhereOrg and NPI Profile returned HTTP 403 or Cloudflare challenges to direct fetches; only individual profile pages surfaced through search were usable, so those directories were not mined systematically.
Google web search (including its local pack) returned a CAPTCHA; Google Maps in the browser was the working map source, capped at ~5 results per query.

Milltown borough website has no public business directory or licensed-business list, and there is no Milltown chamber of commerce member directory online; the 4th of July sponsor page was the closest local business list.

The City-Data New Jersey entity registry lists roughly a thousand 'Milltown' corporations, but they are overwhelmingly holding companies, investment vehicles and nonprofits with no addresses or operating evidence; it was screened lightly and not mined as a business list. If the owner wants shell-entity-level completeness, that registry is the next place to look.
Phone numbers and websites are missing for many personal-care and contractor listings because Google Maps list view did not print them; triage should pull them from the linked listing.
